title: Burying people in their favorite clothes
summary: They discuss burying the dead in favorite suits, Masonic caps or even shoes, as in the case of a preacher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I know when I went to see Papa Celestan, you know, at the way, in the bottom, yeah I think he had his Masonic cap on every day.
Do you know they do that?

Oh yeah, sure, sure. They're bearing with whatever they desire or like. You understand, that's what they actually, remember, I know one fellow's bearing with his shoes on, because he was a preacher, you know. They're bearing with his shoes on.
Well I never thought about that.
Yeah, it was buried right down, yeah.
You mean ordinarily they take the shoes off, huh?
No, they put the shoes on.
But he was buried with his shoes on.
